svg.text: Industrials went from YC's fifth-largest industry label to its second
Rank of the eight top-level industry labels by number of companies within each batch, Winter 2019 to Fall 2026.
Ties broken alphabetically. Hollow marker: batch with fewer than 50 companies.
Source: YC company directory via github.com/yc-oss/api, snapshot 2026-09-06.
